title: sideritis candicans var. stricta
intro: Sideritis candicans var. stricta, commonly known as mountain tea or Greek mountain tea, is a species of flowering plant in the genus Sideritis. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of respiratory issues, where it acts as an expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant. The health benefits of Sideritis candicans var. stricta include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory function, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
